final_audit.ambiguous_policy: Exclude semantic-ambiguous views from detector precision/recall; treat them as non-positive for localization-admission precision, matching Stage 06.
final_audit.selection_use: Pass/fail release evidence only. No detector, gate, correction, covariance, availability architecture, threshold, or hyperparameter may be changed from final-audit outcomes.

navigation_campaign_after_release.runtime_sensor_chain: One frozen 960 detector, Stage-06 gate, Stage-07 hull+ridge mean and R2C covariance, Stage-08 Q1 availability; no model ensembles.
navigation_campaign_after_release.primary_comparison: Matched planner arms differ only in future availability: Q0 per-camera constant versus commissioned Q1 geometry. Runtime camera measurements and fusion are identical.
navigation_campaign_after_release.secondary_aggregation_comparison: On shared captured observation streams, compare best-single, conditionally independent fusion, and a dependence-aware network rule after simultaneous residual dependence is estimated from commissioning data.
navigation_campaign_after_release.replication_unit: complete navigation run; pair seeds across arms and retain timeouts, collisions, detector misses, gate refusals and integrity failures
navigation_campaign_after_release.minimum_initial_campaign: four predeclared routes times five paired seeds times two primary planner arms

prohibitions: Do not drop misses, refusals, timeouts, collisions or integrity failures.
Do not compare belief and reference values at different timestamps.
Do not attribute a planner-arm difference when any runtime sensor or controller setting differs.
Do not call deterministic exact-state availability repeated Bernoulli noise.
